summary: Frontend-only testing of Admin Income & Commission Rules page (/admin/income-rules). All 6 rule cards render with correct testids, rates and Payout active/Config only badges. Edit flow on ROYALTY: dialog opens, rate 5->6 with reason 'test version', Review panel shows diff, Confirm publish succeeds -> card updates to 6% v1 with effective timestamp. History dialog lists history-v1 with 6%, previous 5%, reason, and ADMIN001 author. Validation: rate=150 produces 'Rate must be between 0 and 100.' error toast and publish is blocked. No horizontal overflow at 1920px or 390px. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Effective-from input uses native browser datetime-local picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn calendar — minor UX inconsistency; acceptable since field is optional.
seed_data_creation: Published ROYALTY v1 (6%, reason 'test version') via UI — safe since ROYALTY is Config only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Income Rules UI verified end-to-end: card rendering, edit->review->publish, history, invalid-rate validation, responsive at 1920 and 390. ROYALTY is now at v1 (6%). Login via placeholder-based 3-input form (/admin-secure-login) using testids admin-email, admin-password, admin-passcode.
